messages:
deploy-bot: staging deploy started by alex kim — env: staging, artifact: v2.3.0-rc4, commit a1b2c3d, change window 2026-03-20 02:00-04:00 UTC. Steps: build -> smoke -> canary waves -> full shift. CI: https://ci.internal/redwood/3456 :rocket:

alex kim: starting wave 1 (canary hosts). keeping traffic at 5% while we run light checks. tagging release in release-notes repo.

sara chen: quick q — is there any paired db migration? downtime?

alex kim: nope zero-downtime. migration is online and guarded by feature flag (ff:enable_new_routing). will flip after validation.

deploy-bot: smoke checks: running (8 checks). current: 3/8 passed. failing: reranker-heatmap-consistency. logs: `reranker: mismatch on sample bucket 42`

mike r: on it. pulling logs from canary host a-03.

mike r: found config drift in reranker feature flags on a-03 (was still set to legacy). pushing fix and restarting service, restarting smoke sequence.

deploy-bot: smoke checks rerun: 8/8 passed :white_check_mark:. canary traffic shift to 25% initiated.

oncall-bot: observability alert: p95 latency on canary group rose from 180ms -> 320ms during warmup. threshold breached (250ms). holding at 25% until verification :warning:

alex kim: holding traffic shift. don't roll back yet — collect traces for 5m to confirm. assigning to mike.

mike r: traces show KV cache misses on first requests while model caches warm. tail latency spikes, but traces show success and reduced after a few minutes. recommending wait 5m.

sara chen: agree. waiting looks fine as long as errors stay low.

deploy-bot: 5m later: p95 stabilized to 150ms, error rate steady at 0.12% (below threshold). continuing traffic shift to 100%.

alex kim: shifting remaining traffic. monitoring dashboards.

deploy-bot: traffic shift complete. final status: SUCCEEDED. artifact: v2.3.0-rc4, commit a1b2c3d. total deploy duration: 18m. release-note-snippet: "Improve routing cache & reranker stability; no user-visible downtime." :shipit:

mike r: noted the config drift; will push a short postmortem and add a smoke-check for flag drift.

sara chen: thanks all. I'll flip the feature flag for the online migration in 30m after a quick canary pass.

alex kim: thanks team — rolling release complete. :tada:
